en: Black‑and‑white streetscape showing ornate late‑19th‑century buildings along a cobblestone street. On the left is a stone building with a sign reading "Döbelner Bank." Next to it stands an elaborate Gothic‑revival style building with steep tiled roofs, turrets, spires, and many arched windows. Farther down the street are additional multi‑story historicist façades. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk or stand on the sidewalk; a horse‑drawn carriage is visible in the distance. The scene has the look of a historic European town center.
